analysis.title: GS Garrett - weekend prep 22 Nov 2026
key_insights: Realized vol delivered what the 6 week straddle priced. Realized ran 2x over a 5 day period and the straddle price more than doubled from 4% to 8.2%, with convexity at panic levels last seen in 2025 liberation day, 2020 covid, 2022 fed hikes, 2010 Europe debt and 2011 downgrade.
Garrett labels the period an 'ai conviction crisis'. Capital intensity, financing needs, ROI and valuations are all being questioned at once, but the AI trade is not abandoned.

Client tone Friday was calmer than spot. Professional nets are already at 1y lows and fundamental L/S managers made about 100bps of alpha vs benchmark this week, but there was no sign of long delta offense being deployed.
Damage is concentrated in former high-conviction themes. Top decile 1H26 names have a median return of -32% since July, while breadth has held up better than the index.

Spiking volume and implied vol together has historically signaled a crescendo rather than continuation. Friday's option expiry often coincides with implied vol peaks, and NVDA rallied 3.7% post close Friday after Nov options expired.

With the ~8% long run annualized equity return priced as the ~8% 6 week breakeven, implied vol is hard to push materially higher without something breaking. Garrett favors long delta with net short or flat vega.

Trade ideas: window knock outs, VIX calendar put spreads, knock out calls on baskets or singles, and short puts in most convicted longs. Garrett agrees with Ben Snider that hyperscalers are the vol adjusted best place for capital.

Prime book: HFs net sold US equities for a 3rd straight week and 6 of the last 7, driven by single stock shorts. Positioning is at the 5th percentile 1y and 3rd percentile 3y, with beta-adjusted net at the 1st percentile 3y.
Single stock shorting is accelerating. Shorted every day this week, the largest weekly shorting since Jun 2022 and third largest of the decade, with gross exposure still high.
One delta flow: ETF share of tape topped 39% Friday, pointing to top-down macro flows. Long only selling in semiconductors was persistent with buyers frozen, and SMH is down 41% from mid-June highs.
CTAs sold $57bn of US equities over the past month and flipped net short. GS models show them selling across all scenarios this week, and NDX CTA positioning is near the bottom of its 10y range.
Liquidity is thin. SPX top of book liquidity fell to about $4mm, near YTD lows, likely amplifying realized vol.

Derivs: VIX above 35 with an inverted curve and extreme skew, and the panic index at 9.8 of 10. The weekly VIX rise was the 5th largest on record, and readings above 9.5 have historically signaled near-term relief.
Comparable VIX spikes (Oct 08, May 10, Feb 20, Apr 25) saw average subsequent SPX returns of +5.1% next day, +3.3% next week, +5.9% next 3 months and +26.5% next 1 year.
Friday was the 4th largest option volume session ever at 104.5mm contracts. The 29 names with Mon/Wed/Fri expiries realize 82 vol, and NVDA was 30% of SPX constituent single stock option volume.
Baskets show 2018 deja vu. High-beta cyclicals are +12% YTD vs US AI negative, and in 4Q18 cyclicals fell 23%. At 15x fwd P/E valuations remain about 40% above the 2018 trough.
